import pytest
from isort.output import sorted_imports
from collections import defaultdict

class Config:
    def __init__(self, remove_imports=None, no_sections=False, only_sections=False,
                 lines_between_types=0, from_first=False, star_first=False,
                 lines_after_imports=0, lines_before_imports=0,
                 import_headings=None, import_footers=None, ensure_newline_before_comments=False):
        self.remove_imports = remove_imports or []
        self.no_sections = no_sections
        self.only_sections = only_sections
        self.lines_between_types = lines_between_types
        self.from_first = from_first
        self.star_first = star_first
        self.lines_after_imports = lines_after_imports
        self.lines_before_imports = lines_before_imports
        self.import_headings = import_headings or {}
        self.import_footers = import_footers or {}
        self.ensure_newline_before_comments = ensure_newline_before_comments

DEFAULT_CONFIG = Config()

@pytest.fixture
def parsed_content():
    return {
        "import_index": 0,
        "lines_without_imports": ["print('Hello World')"],
        "sections": defaultdict(dict),
        "imports": defaultdict(lambda: {"straight": {}, "from": {}}),
        "line_separator": "\n"
    }

def test_sorted_imports_with_no_imports(parsed_content):
    parsed_content["import_index"] = -1
    assert sorted_imports(parsed_content, DEFAULT_CONFIG) == "print('Hello World')"

def test_sorted_imports_with_imports(parsed_content):
    parsed_content["imports"]["FIRST"]["straight"]["module_a"] = "import module_a"
    parsed_content["imports"]["SECOND"]["straight"]["module_b"] = "import module_b"
    parsed_content["sections"] = ["FIRST", "SECOND"]
    assert sorted_imports(parsed_content, DEFAULT_CONFIG) == "import module_a\nimport module_b\nprint('Hello World')"

def test_sorted_imports_with_custom_configurations(parsed_content):
    parsed_content["imports"]["FIRST"]["straight"]["b_module"] = "import b_module"
    parsed_content["imports"]["FIRST"]["from"]["a_module"] = "from a_module import something"
    parsed_content["sections"] = ["FIRST"]
    custom_config = Config(
        remove_imports=[],
        no_sections=False,
        only_sections=False,
        lines_between_types=1,
        from_first=True
    )
    assert sorted_imports(parsed_content, custom_config) == "from a_module import something\n\nimport b_module\nprint('Hello World')"

def test_sorted_imports_with_star_imports(parsed_content):
    parsed_content["imports"]["FIRST"]["from"]["*"] = "from module_with_star import *"
    parsed_content["sections"] = ["FIRST"]
    custom_config = Config(star_first=True)
    assert sorted_imports(parsed_content, custom_config) == "from module_with_star import *\nprint('Hello World')"

def test_sorted_imports_with_empty_sections(parsed_content):
    parsed_content["imports"]["FIRST"]["straight"] = {}
    parsed_content["imports"]["FIRST"]["from"] = {}
    parsed_content["sections"] = ["FIRST"]
    assert sorted_imports(parsed_content, DEFAULT_CONFIG) == "print('Hello World')"
